records.title: Welcome to Niagara Catholic (registration)
records.summary: Start online, then finish at the school in person with your child's birth certificate, a baptism record (the child's or a parent's), proof of address and any custody papers. Baptized Catholic children, and children with a Catholic parent, are entitled to attend a Catholic elementary school; the board accepts other children at the principal's discretion, as space is available. Students do not need to be Catholic to attend a Niagara Catholic high school.

records.title: Admission of Elementary and Secondary Students (procedure 301.1, PDF)
records.summary: Students attend the home school for their address. To ask for a school outside your area, meet the principal and submit the board's request form; the Family of Schools superintendent approves or refuses in writing. If approved, parents are responsible for transportation. The procedure gives no application deadline.

records.title: Which school do I attend? (Niagara Student Transportation Services)
records.summary: The board's own "finding your home school" link goes to this lookup, run by its transportation consortium. Choose Niagara Catholic and the school year. The transportation office has the final word if anything disagrees.

records.title: French Immersion
records.summary: French Immersion starts in Grade 1. Registration opens once a year in January (for 2026-27 it ran January 12 to 30); the board posts each year's dates on this page. Places go first to siblings of current Immersion students, then to children inside the school's boundary, then to others if space allows, with a waitlist kept until September 30.

records.title: French Immersion
records.summary: French Immersion continues in Grades 9 to 12 at four Niagara Catholic high schools. There is no separate online registration for secondary French Immersion.

records.title: Student Transportation Policy (500.2)
records.summary: Students who live at least 0.8 km (kindergarten), 1.6 km (Grades 1 to 8) or 3.2 km (Grades 9 to 12) from their home school, by the shortest walking route, may get transportation. Families of students approved to attend outside their area provide transportation themselves. Niagara Student Transportation Services runs the buses.

related.title: Check transportation eligibility for an address (NSTS)

records.title: Special Education
records.summary: The board's special education page, with its 2026-2027 Special Education Plan and a guide for parents and guardians. Start with your child's teacher and principal; parents give written consent before assessments.

records.title: Special Education Advisory Committee (SEAC)
records.summary: SEAC holds monthly public meetings during the school year at the Catholic Education Centre and advises the board on special education.

records.title: Accessibility
records.summary: The board's 2022-2027 Multi-Year Accessibility Plan, reviewed every two years. It describes board-wide plans, not the features of a particular school building; ask the school about specific needs.

records.title: Newcomer and English language support
records.summary: We could not find a Niagara Catholic page for newcomer families or English language learners. Ask the school what support is offered; registration asks for proof of immigration status.

records.title: 2024-2029 Long Term Accommodation Plan (PDF)
records.summary: The board's plan for school space: capacity, enrolment, projections and recommended reviews by family of schools. Its recommendations are subject to public consultation and are not decisions.

records.title: Student Achievement Plan (PDF)
records.summary: The board's plan under Ontario's student achievement framework: reading, writing and math (EQAO and the OSSLT), graduation, credits, pathways, suspensions, attendance and awareness of mental health supports, each next to Ontario's. It does not set numeric targets. These are board-wide figures, not this school's.

records.title: Niagara Catholic Parent Involvement Committee
records.summary: Meets every other month during the school year and links parents, Catholic School Councils, the Director of Education and trustees. Each school has a Catholic School Council; ask the school how to join.

records.title: Trustees
records.summary: Your elected trustees, by area, and how to reach them. Board meetings are public; dates, agendas and minutes are posted.

records.title: Student and Family Support Office
records.summary: Start with the teacher, then the principal, then the Family of Schools superintendent; if it is still not settled, the Student and Family Support Office helps. The office aims to acknowledge within 2 business days.

decisions.title: Saint Michael and Saint Paul family of schools attendance area review (Niagara Falls)
decisions.summary: On June 16, 2026 the board approved new attendance boundaries ("Option 2") for this family of schools. They take effect when the new South Niagara Falls Catholic elementary school opens; the board had not published an opening date when we checked. Check the review page for the new boundary for your address.
decisions.match: Names in the approved motion matched by hand to this site's schools in Niagara Falls (Our Lady of Mount Carmel, Sacred Heart, Loretto, Father Hennepin, St. John Henry Newman, St. Patrick, St. Mary, St. Gabriel Lalemant, St. Vincent de Paul, Mary Ward, Notre Dame, Saint Michael CHS, Saint Paul CHS).
